capabilities: Run ADS queries from ads code blocks
Write results as Markdown tables with ADS and DOI links
Validate search keys against ADS searchable fields
Configure default columns, sort order, and results per query
Store the ADS API token in Obsidian's encrypted secret storage
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.11.5+ because the token is stored with encryption at rest; the token is local to each device and vault and must be configured per device. Users are subject to the ADS API Terms of Use.
problem: Researchers using NASA ADS must leave Obsidian to search it, and results are not stored natively in their notes.

relations.evidence: Queries are sent over the network to the NASA ADS API using an API token

summary: Runs NASA ADS searches from ads code blocks and writes the results as Markdown tables with ADS and DOI links.
